blocks.html:
Best Pickup Truck Wrap Shop In GTA

Trucks are large vehicles and almost impossible to ignore while on the road, which is why trucks are a perfect way to advertise your business. Being large in build, trucks have all this extra real estate on them which people usually forget about. Once you realize that you can be using your truck to promote your business, it’s quite unusual to not do anything about it. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has been working in the industry for years, wrapping vehicles of all kinds. We do full wraps, partial wraps, truck decals and truck lettering. Whether it is a personal pickup truck or your fleet of business trucks, we will make sure your truck grabs the attention wherever it goes.

We effectively communicate with our customers to bring their dream truck wraps to life. You have full freedom over the type of text, graphics or images you want to use for your pickup truck wrap design.

We have designed and installed wraps for trucks including but not limited to:

  • Ford F-150 / F-Series
  • Chevy Silverado
  • Nissan Frontier
  • GMC Canyon
  • Toyota Tacoma
  • RAM 1500
  • RAM 2500
  • RAM 3500
  • Toyota Tundra
  • GMC Sierra
  • Nissan Titan
  • Ford Ranger
  • Freightliner M2
  • Hino 258

Truck Wrap FAQs

1) How long do truck wraps last?

On average, truck wraps can last up to 5-7 years depending on the quality of material and maintenance.

2) What kind of trucks do you wrap?

Small or big, we wrap all kinds of trucks.

3) Do you offer design services?

Yes, We do. If you’re starting from scratch or looking for a new concept, our design team will design an eye-catching wrap for your truck or fleet.

4) How long does it take to wrap a truck?

Depending on the complexity and size of the truck, it can take anywhere between 1 to 5 days.

Check out our portfolio page to see how some of our loyal customers are using their fleet to promote their businesses.

To read articles about vehicle wraps, visit our blog page.

If you have any questions or concerns about truck wrap cost, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to get a quote to wrap your pickup truck.
